source_title: Tradier Brokerage Data Breach Investigation: Edelson Lechtzin LLP Probes Class Action Claims After a Vendor Attack Exposes Social Security Numbers
source_excerpt:
National class action law firm offers free, confidential case evaluations to Tradier Brokerage customers and others whose personal information may have been exposed.
NEWTOWN, Pa. , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Edelson Lechtzin LLP , a national class action law firm, is investigating data privacy claims arising from a data breach affecting Tradier Brokerage Inc., a Charlotte, North Carolina-based online broker-dealer. Anyone who received a breach notice or believes their information may have been exposed can request a free case evaluation .
On August 28, 2026, a cyberattack targeted Etna Software Corporation, a third-party vendor that provides the order management system and pre-trade controls Tradier uses to operate its brokerage business. Tradier became aware of the incident on September 3, 2026. Tradier has said that its own internal network was not compromised and remained secure throughout the incident, and that the breach was limited to systems and data held by Etna.
Tradier began notifying affected customers by email and disclosed the incident to the California Attorney General. According to regulatory filings, the incident has affected 9,404 Texas residents and 1,580 Massachusetts residents so far. Tradier has said it is reviewing its third-party relationships and its data minimization program.
According to Tradier Brokerage, the personal information that may have been accessed includes:
Government-issued tax identification numbers
Because Social Security numbers and tax identification numbers are among the most sensitive categories of personal information, the exposure creates a heightened risk of identity theft and financial fraud for affected individuals.
The investigation focuses on Tradier Brokerage customers whose personal information was held in the Etna systems used to operate Tradier's brokerage business. Tradier has arranged with Cyberscout, a TransUnion company, to provide affected individuals up to two years of complimentary credit monitoring and identity theft protection; eligible individuals must enroll within 90 days of receiving their notification letter.
Edelson Lechtzin LLP is investigating a potential class action on behalf of individuals whose data may have been compromised. A successful case could recover compensation for losses such as lost time, out-of-pocket costs, and loss of privacy, and could press Tradier Brokerage to strengthen its data protection. The firm evaluates claims at no cost.
Watch for the notice from Tradier Brokerage and keep the enclosed code for the free credit monitoring being offered, enrolling within 90 days.
Place a free fraud alert or credit freeze with Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion, and obtain your free reports at AnnualCreditReport.com.
Review your account statements for anything you do not recognize, and report suspected identity theft to the Federal Trade Commission at IdentityTheft.gov.
Speak confidentially with a data privacy attorney: Marc Edelson, Esq., Edelson Lechtzin LLP , 411 S. State Street, Suite N-300, Newtown, PA 18940; Phone: 844-696-7492 ; Email: [email protected] ; or click HERE to request a free consultation.
Edelson Lechtzin LLP is a national class action law firm with offices in Pennsylvania and California. Beyond data breach litigation, the firm handles class and collective actions involving securities and investment fraud , antitrust violations, ERISA benefit plans, wage theft , and consumer fraud .
